entities.name: Slug
entities.description: Creature type depicting shell-less snail-like terrestrial gastropods.

entities.name: Thermopod
entities.description: Slug descendants on Dominaria that developed heated bellies to skate over ice; they became Snow creatures.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era on Dominaria during which thermopods evolved from giant slugs.

events.summary: Thermopods evolve from giant slugs, developing a furnace-like organ in their bellies.
events.quote: Thermopods developed a furnace-like organ in their bellies.

events.summary: Thermopods become specialized Snow creatures reliant on the cold.
events.quote: they've become Snow creatures, reliant on the cold for survival
